data_fields.name: capture_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: CaptureRate per pet entry, 0..10000 (10000 = 100%); 0 is floored to 1

best_idea: A capture is one server roll against a catalogue rate out of 10000 that rises as the target's HP falls (C * (200 - hp%) / 100, floor 1), gated by lure match, distance, a free slot and visibility, and spent on every attempt.
decision_why: Keep the single roll, the HP-scaled rate and the floor, but make a zero rate an explicit not-capturable flag (the donor floor turns 0 into 0.01%) and consume the lure in the same server step as the roll (the donor FIXME at pet.cpp:1267).
acceptance: A server test with a catalogue rate of 2000 asserts that a full-HP target is captured in about 20% of seeded rolls and a target at 1% HP in about 40%; a roll above the rate leaves the target alive and the lure spent; a rate of 0 refuses the attempt outright.
